import random, sys, time, json, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')

import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def gen_hard(rng, nflows, nnodes, capmax=2, tievals=True, pinned=0):
    nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(nnodes)]
    caps=dict((n,rng.randint(1,capmax)) for n in nodes)
    flows=[]; offers={}
    H=8
    for i in range(nflows):
        k=rng.randint(2,min(4,nnodes))
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        nd=rng.randint(0,H-5)
        kinds=['D']*nd+['Q','T']+['K']*(H-2-nd)
        rng.shuffle(kinds)
        tmpl=bytes(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(H))
        fid='f%02d'%i
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=''.join(kinds)))
        hdr=bytearray(tmpl)
        for j,c in enumerate(kinds):
            if c=='D': hdr[j]=rng.randint(0,255)
            if c=='Z': hdr[j]=rng.randint(0,255)
        hdr[kinds.index('Q')]=rng.randint(0,7)
        hdr[kinds.index('T')]=k+rng.randint(0,5)
        cnt = rng.randint(1,4) if tievals else rng.randint(1,50)
        offers[fid]=[dict(header=bytes(hdr).hex(),count=cnt)]
    ids=[f['id'] for f in flows]
    pin=rng.sample(ids,pinned) if pinned else []
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=rng.choice([0,0,1]),pinned=pin,offers=offers)
